description: On one dynaset over F (IDs 1-8; N 10,20,30,40,40,50,60,70; S alpha, beta, O'Brien, a"b, abc, ABC, abd, Null; D with a time part, a repeated date and Nulls; Q x, Null, y), for each criterion [D = #1/15/2020# ;; D = #15 Jan 2020# ;; D = #2020-01-15# ;; D = #1/15/20# ;; D = #2/20/2020 1:30:00 PM# ;; D = #2/20/2020# ;; D = #2/20/2020 13:30# ;; D >= #1/1/2021# ;; D < #1/1/2020# ;; D = 43845 ;; D = 43845.0 ;; D = '1/15/2020' ;; D = #15/1/2020# ;; D = #1/32/2020# ;; D = CDate('1/15/2020') ;; D = DateSerial(2020, 1, 15) ;; D = #1/15/2020# AND N = 40 ;; D Between #1/1/2020# And #1/31/2020# ;; D = #1/15/2020 12:00:00 AM#]: FindFirst, then FindNext x1, with the same criterion; after each call read NoMatch, BOF, EOF and ID. Asks which date literal spellings, serial numbers, string dates and date functions the criteria accept, how a time part takes part in equality, and which of the two rows dated 1/15/2020 each FindFirst and FindNext reach. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
